title: Ember Reservoir
hero_description: a squat brass walking furnace with white-hot window eyes and vivid orange legs
story_premise: A courier furnace must preserve its last living coal while crossing a frozen reservoir.
theme_thread: The draining heat is the coal's life, and every refill spends the abandoned stations' final fuel.
win_condition: Remain warm and intact until the rescue beacon arrives.
lose_condition: Heat reaches zero or all lives are lost.

levels.name: The White Crossing
levels.description: a vast cyan ice sheet split by black cracks, rusted orange braziers, and blowing snow
levels.outro_beat: The rescue lamp finds a heartbeat in the white. The coal opens one small golden eye.
levels.pressure_notes: Use a rising drain rate, sparse finite refill fuel, three fast hazards, and a nearly refill-less final stretch.

art_style: graphic hand-painted arcade art with cold cyan fields and incandescent orange silhouettes
audio_mood: urgent metallic percussion under lonely winter wind

key_item.description: a jagged translucent ice wisp with a dark blue core and sharp trailing fins

extra_sprites.name: coal_brazier
extra_sprites.description: a rusted iron tripod bowl holding a small geometric orange coal flame
